cards.title: The difference of squares: quick review
cards.body: $a^2 - b^2 = (a + b)(a - b)$. Read it both ways: subtract squares by multiplying, or multiply around a middle number by subtracting squares.

cards.title: Squaring near a round number: quick review
cards.body: $n^2 = (n - b)(n + b) + b^2$. Pick $b$ so one factor is round: $48^2 = 46 \times 50 + 4 = 2304$.

cards.title: How the check works
cards.body: First a short warm-up. Then the check: $8$ questions, easiest first, no hints. Type each answer. You need all $8$ right to pass. If you miss one, you’ll see how to do it, and the next try gives you new numbers.
